name: Elymas/Bar-Jesus (sorcerer)
title: The Sorcerer of Cyprus
summary: Elymas, also called Bar-Jesus, was a Jewish sorcerer and false prophet who served the Roman proconsul Sergius Paulus on Cyprus. He opposed the apostles Paul and Barnabas as they preached the gospel but was struck with blindness as God's judgment against his resistance to the truth.

keyEvents.title: Served the proconsul of Cyprus
keyEvents.description: Elymas served as an advisor and sorcerer to the Roman proconsul Sergius Paulus and held influence at his court.

keyEvents.title: Opposed the preaching of the gospel
keyEvents.description: When Sergius Paulus wanted to hear God's word from Paul and Barnabas, Elymas actively tried to prevent the proconsul from coming to faith.

keyEvents.title: Paul rebukes Elymas
keyEvents.description: Filled with the Holy Spirit, Paul confronted Elymas directly, calling him a son of the devil and an enemy of all righteousness who twists the Lord's right ways.

keyEvents.title: Struck with blindness
keyEvents.description: As God's judgment against his resistance, Elymas was struck with blindness for a time, and he groped around seeking someone to lead him.

keyEvents.title: The Proconsul's Conversion
keyEvents.description: When Sergius Paulus saw what happened to Elymas, he believed, amazed at the teaching of the Lord.
